== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[Eventually You'll Lose (V)]] (Original text), as published: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/04fafe9a4fc2c8a87e045ba98e3a4c685106d50c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/eventuallyyoulllose.gif Holotable image repository, commit 04fafe9] “Set 21 plus stuff”, 18 June 2023. Uploaded unchanged (byte-for-byte copy of that commit's file; the PC stores it as PNG data under a .gif name, so it is uploaded here with a .png extension). Later replaced at the same address by the next version's image.
